description.blurb: 2102 Tantalus is an Apollo asteroid about 2–4 km in diameter.
description.more: 2102 Tantalus is a potentially hazardous asteroid (PHA) because its minimum orbit intersection distance (MOID) is less than 0.05 AU and its diameter is greater than 150 meters. The Earth-MOID is 0.0439 AU (6,570,000 km; 4,080,000 mi), or about 17.2 lunar distances.
